title: Hold a licence to explore for or recover minerals in coastal waters
what: Explore for or recover minerals in South Australian coastal waters only under a licence or special purpose consent.

sources.title: Offshore Minerals Act 2000 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) explore for minerals in coastal waters; or (b) recover minerals from coastal waters, unless the exploration or recovery is authorised by a licence or special purpose consent granted under this Act
